properties.displayName: SOC-LAB-002 - Azure RBAC Role Assignment Monitoring
properties.description: Monitors successful Azure role assignment writes, regardless of privilege level.
properties.query:
// SOC-LAB-002: Azure RBAC Role Assignment Monitoring
// Status: Rule created, disabled
// Data source: AzureActivity
// Severity: Low
// Validation: Synthetic KQL testing
// Scope: Successful role assignments, not privileged roles only

AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| where OperationNameValue =~
    "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE"
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *)
    by CorrelationId, ResourceId, Caller
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Caller,
    CallerIpAddress,
    OperationNameValue,
    ActivityStatusValue,
    ResourceId,
    ResourceGroup,
    CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
